name: mixmind-by-piradex
description: MIXMIND by Piradex — app (sem build) + loja/licenças (server/, Node 22 sem dependências). Este package.json serve para testes e para arrancar a loja.

scripts.test: node tests/dsp.test.mjs && node tests/tune.test.mjs && node tests/e2e.test.mjs && node tests/cloud.test.mjs && npm run test:loja
